title: Unraveling the Red Tape
description: Unraveling the Red Tape — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Deidre the Resourceful

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Use the Obelisk to return to Dew Valley and give Deidre the Resourceful your signed certificate.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Deidre the Resourceful

Repeatable: No

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Use the Obelisk to return to Dew Valley and give Deidre the Resourceful your signed certificate.

Offer:

It's odd that the Ministry of Human Resources always asks us trainers to sign certificates...Deidre could have actually signed this herself. Anyway, I signed your certificate. Bring it back to Deidre the Resourceful in Dew Valley.

Before you leave, don't forget to browse the lists of skills and abilities that I (and my fellow trainers) can teach you.

Tip: Any character can train in any profession. For example, Fighters can learn Fighter skills, but they can also learn Ranger or Mage skills. Feel free to experiment with using skills from all three professions.

Turn-in:

Thank you for your signed certificate. I shall file it into your permanent record.

...Hm? Why are you still standing there?

If it will keep you from interrupting my work, you can have three King's Coins. Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative in Dew Valley will explain how to use them. Also, I think Sir Lee of York may be trying to catch your attention.

Did you expect a parade? It's official: Now you're a Dungeon Runner. Now go run dungeons, or whatever it is you people do, and let me get back to work.

Tip: Many quests will give you a reward after successful completion. Quest rewards can include gold or items (such as King's Coin).

Level range: 1–5
